appName: Bus Simulation VR – Bus Driving Game
displayName: Bus Simulation VR – Bus Driving Game
display_name: Bus Simulation VR – Bus Driving Game
display_long_description:
Step into the driver’s seat with Bus Simulation VR – Bus Driving Game, a realistic virtual reality bus driving experience designed for Meta Quest.

Navigate through lively city streets, stop at bus stations, pick and drop passengers, and follow real traffic rules in an immersive VR environment. Feel authentic bus handling with smooth steering, braking, and acceleration optimized for VR controllers.

Whether you want a calm driving experience or a professional bus driver challenge, this simulator offers detailed environments, realistic sounds, and engaging gameplay that makes you feel like a real city bus driver.

Perfect for simulation lovers, VR driving fans, and players who enjoy realistic transport games.

Key Features
🚍 Realistic bus driving physics
🕹️ Immersive VR steering & controls
🏙️ Detailed city environments
🚦 Traffic rules & signals system
🧍 Passenger pick & drop missions
🔊 Authentic engine & city sounds
⚡ Smooth performance optimized for Meta Quest
